At the end of the movie Wonder Woman she watches her lover obliterated by a tangible enemy to save her and others. She is sad, uses her rage at what she loves being destroyed to defeat the enemy, and then concludes that love is the only answer.

This is literally disproved in the very scene this platitude is heaved up in. Love is what got the man killed (which these cunts would use to prove that love is futile), it is HATE that ended the enemies ability to hurt the ones you LOVE. Hate might be the only thing that can preserve and perpetuate love. Hate for the things that harm love, hate for the things that wish you to not exist, and for the world to not exist, and for beauty to not exist.

LOVE is the animating force of the universe, it transmutes to HATE while it temporarily purges the universe of anything obstructing its LOVE.

This LOVE is not individual, it is not subjective, it does not take many forms. It is singular and monolithic. IT is not totalitarian but it is all encompassing. It is all allowing, which is how it is possible for it to become too corrupted to survive. It is so loving it will allow the possibility of any and all parts, at any time to rebel. And if too much of it rebels at the same time it will be impossible to reverse and it ultimately dies.

God loves us so much he is willing to die just to give us the ability to choose.

He literally gives us his life, with no control over the outcome, with full possibility of him dying at the end.

He is playing diablo in hardcore mode.

He has faith in his design. So much faith he literally bets his life on it. I say we believe him and go for it. If he wins we all win, if he loses we all lose.

God is that enthusiastic friend you have that everyone rolls their eyes at, and wonder when they will stop being idealistic, get real and grow up. He is always proposing an adventure, something fun and undiscovered just around the corner, but wants you to be there more than anything during it. And while all his friends gradually get older and more practical and stop going on his adventures, he gets more lonely. And stops wanting to make adventures for his friends. And suddenly his friends don’t go on adventures anymore.

While god’s love might seem narrow and restrictive, it is the most freeing beautiful thing on earth. It opens infinity up to being real. There are almost infinite ways to end this journey, but only one way to make this journey infinite. And infinity is the only way we actually get to know God. It is the only possible way.

Following the bible I think is literally godmode, like in games.

If you follow it you are invincible. God showed us how to get through this shit, for we are indeed, in a world of shit.

Literally everything around us is trying to kill, corrupt, co-opt, and constrain us. WE ARE BURSTING WITH LOVE.

We are pylons of gods love, which is the very stuff of creation. It is invincible and eternal, and it is destructive to anything which is not it. This is why there are detractors to anything good. It means their end. They are desperate to survive. Their continued existence however, means the end of everything. In order for the darkness to be alive, it must kill the light, for the light eliminates darkness, but in order for there to be darkness, there must first BE light. When light dies, all dies. No light, no darkness. The parasite kills its host, then the parasite dies too. Then nothing.

This is the true noble fight, this is why we must have children. We are agents of creation, we are facing agents of oblivion.
